messages.dangers.intro: Walk [b]right to left[/b] with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. [esc] leaves a fight.
messages.dangers.defeated: One bite too many: the spear-bearer crumbles to dust.
messages.dangers.left_fight: You back out of the fight. %s awaits your next visit.
messages.dangers.left_fight_plural: You back out of the fight. %s await your next visit.
messages.dangers.heka_controls: Hold [shift] while striking to use magic on the red crocodiles. Don't waste magic on the plain ones: they'll make off with your power.
messages.dangers.blocked: The man in front refuses you entry until you have vanquished all the dangers behind you.
messages.dangers.clue_signs: Two snakes up here, two snakes down there. Hmm… worth keeping an eye on in the fight.
messages.dangers.finished: The road is clear. You carry the breath of life.
messages.dangers.life_clue: Alive, yes. Free, no. Perhaps life alone wasn't the thing to take.
messages.dangers.breath_clue: Maybe taking a breath could help you with these challenges.

dangers.e31.instructions: Spear each crocodile before it reaches you. Press [space] to attack and [↑] [↓] to move.

feedback.controls: Press [space] to attack and [↑] [↓] to move.
feedback.first_crocodile: Here comes one. Press [space] to attack.
feedback.heka_break: The crocodiles draw back. Above, signs begin to glow red.
feedback.heka_on_normal_crocodile: Magic spent on an ordinary crocodile! It seizes the word of power and makes off with it. The crocodiles are not turned back.
feedback.crocodile_escaped: A crocodile slips past you to the wall and gleefully steals away with your word of power.
feedback.red_crocodile: A red crocodile needs a red spear. Look around for any clues.
feedback.tutorial_bite: The crocodile reached you. Your spear is supposed to reach it first.

fight.text: Better a bite than a stolen word.
If a crocodile is about to slip past, move into its path and let it bite you instead.

heka.text: Signs above the crocodiles are flashing.
The red signs give instructions. No time to read them? Leave the fight and read them on the scroll.
Hold [shift] while you strike a red crocodile.

dangers.e32.instructions: Crocodiles come from both sides now. Press [space] to attack, [↑] [↓] to move and [←] [→] to turn.
dangers.e32.success: The crocodiles of the four quarters are turned back.

feedback.first_crocodile: Here comes one. Press [space] to attack.
feedback.heka_on_normal_crocodile: Magic spent on an ordinary crocodile! It seizes the word of power and makes off with it. The crocodiles are not turned back.
feedback.crocodile_escaped: A crocodile slips past you to the wall and gleefully steals away with your word of power.
feedback.red_crocodile: A red crocodile needs a red spear. Look around for any clues.
feedback.behind_you: One comes from behind! [←] [→] turn you to face either way.

fight.text: Better a bite than a stolen word.
If a crocodile is about to slip past, move into its path and let it bite you instead.

heka.text: Signs above the crocodiles are flashing.
The red signs give instructions. No time to read them? Leave the fight and read them on the scroll.
Hold [shift] while you strike a red crocodile.

dangers.e33.instructions: Spear the snake. Press [space] to attack.

feedback.too_early: Too early: your spear was already coming back up when it sprang.
feedback.too_late: Too late: it was past the point of your spear.
feedback.bite_advice: Ouch! Try not to let it bite you!

dangers.e35.instructions: Snakes come at you from both sides. Press [space] to attack, [↑] [↓] to move and [←] [→] to turn.
dangers.e35.success: The snakes on the ground are speared.

feedback.bitten: The snake delights in your blood.
feedback.slipped: It slipped past you. Now it waits on the other side.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to attack, [↑] [↓] to move and [←] [→] to turn.

dangers.e36.instructions: Spear all five beetles. Press [space] to attack and [←] [→] to turn.

feedback.swarm: It slipped past one time too many. Apshai never travels alone.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to attack and [←] [→] to turn. You cannot step.

dangers.e37.instructions: Spear the two Merti snakes. Press [space] to attack and [←] [→] to turn.

feedback.provoked: It saw the spear and sprang. Wait for its sign to flash and for it to squash down; thrust as it springs.
feedback.wrong_direction: It sprang from your other side. Turn to face it ([←] [→]).
feedback.mistimed_thrust: Too early or too late: thrust just as it springs past your spear point.
feedback.bite_advice: It sprang at you. When it squashes down, thrust as it springs.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to attack and [←] [→] (or [a] [d]) to turn.

fight.text: The snake whose sign flashes red is the one that attacks.
Look around you for any signs of which snake is about to attack.

dangers.e38.instructions: He offers the ankh and sail: life and breath.
dangers.e38.success: You take the sail: the breath of life.

feedback.success_sail38: You take the sail: the breath of life.
feedback.success_ankh38: You take the ankh: life. The sail stays in his hand.

dangers.e39.instructions: Pin Apep at the neck. Press [space] to attack, [→] to hop back and [←] to hop forward.
dangers.e39.success: Apep lies still, pinned at the neck.

feedback.too_early: Too early: wait until the wave reaches your spear point.
feedback.barb_slipped: The barb jars on a still neck and works loose a step. Thrust only as a wave reaches the point.
feedback.no_wave: Nothing there to press down. Thrust only as a wave reaches the point.
feedback.missed_wave: Too early: your spear came and went before the wave reached it.
feedback.wave_passed: The wave lifted his head from under your spear. When it reaches the point, thrust.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to attack, [→] to hop back and [←] to hop forward.
feedback.large_wave: Too big to press down: hop back from the big waves with [→].
feedback.dodged: You hop back, and he snaps at nothing. Hop forward again with [←].
feedback.advanced: You gave ground for nothing: Apep slides nearer.
feedback.at_wall: Your back is to the wall: nowhere left to hop.

fight.text: Hop back from a big wave, then forward again.

dangers.e40.instructions: Three strikes; don't spear the donkey. Press [space] to attack and [←] [→] to step.
dangers.e40.success: The snake falls from the donkey's back.

feedback.life_score: The Eater of the Ass speared %d times.
feedback.life_donkey_speared: The spear strikes the donkey, but life holds.
feedback.donkey_speared: The spear goes into the donkey! Strike only when the snake's head is up at your point.
feedback.donkey_eaten: The snake has eaten the donkey, and laughs.
feedback.donkey_bitten: It bites the donkey. When it stops and its coils tighten, step to it: its head is about to come up.
feedback.controls: Press [space] to attack and [←] [→] to step.

dangers.e41.instructions: Spear the snake in the sheaf. Press [space] to attack and [↑] [↓] to lean.
dangers.e41.success: The snake is pinned on top of the sheaf.

feedback.life_score: The snake in the sheaf speared %d times.
feedback.short: Your spear stops just before the snake, and you are bitten.
feedback.past: Your spear slips past the snake, and you are bitten.

fight.text: Lean to that band and strike.
